answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents anchor identity in a cryptographic attestation chain verified through zero-knowledge proofs. A trust atlas maps verified reputations across nodes, while an escrow bridge imposes superlinear staking slashing rules: validating N fake personas requires staking costs scaled as O(2^N). This guarantees exponential capital exhaustion for Sybil swarms, turning identity forgery into a cost-prohibitive sonnet of economic ruin.
